name: Kida Emiri
source:
The younger sister of Tokinori. 
Despite being the younger of the two, Emiri is undoubtedly the more dominant and, in some ways, has seized control of the household. 

Despite their disagreements, Emiri still has a strong bond with her brother. She has learned to lower her expectations of him due to his lack of direction. 
She also respects and admires Yukio.

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/December_When_There_Is_No_Angel]Wikipedia[/url]]
